Technical SEO.title: Google Confirmed Indexing Reporting Bug From Yesterday As Short Blip
Technical SEO.summary: Google Search Console temporarily reported pages as not indexed with a status of Crawled - currently not indexed, but the issue resolved within an hour. John Mueller confirmed the incident and described it as a short blip.

Technical SEO.title: Almost 100% Of People Also Ask Results Are Answered By Google AI Overviews
Technical SEO.summary: Google now answers nearly 100% of all People Also Ask questions with AI Overviews, up from roughly 12% fourteen months ago. This structural shift has significant implications for how SERP features interact with organic click opportunity.

Technical SEO.title: Google Merchant Center AI Performance: AI Search Intent, Terms and Attribution
Technical SEO.summary: Google has added AI Search intent, AI Search terms, and AI attributes to the Merchant Center AI Performance Insights report, which launched in July and has been expanding to more regions. These new metrics give product-focused SEOs additional signals for understanding AI-driven shopping behavior.

Technical SEO.title: Google: Sometimes There Is No Absolute Right Answer For SEO
Technical SEO.summary: John Mueller responded to a practitioner seeking a definitive SEO answer by stating that sometimes there is no absolute right answer, but you can choose one and make it the right answer. The comment reflects Google's ongoing position that many SEO decisions are context-dependent rather than rule-based.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How Freshpet Earned AI Trust: A GEO and AI Visibility Playbook
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Freshpet and Intero Digital share a practical playbook covering how brands can audit AI visibility, restructure content for citation, and connect GEO work to business priorities. The case study is directly applicable to enterprise brands building AI-search strategy.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: 5 AI Models, 4 Signals: What 120K Mentions Reveal About Multi-Location SEO
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A study analyzing 120,000 brand mentions across five AI models including ChatGPT and Gemini identifies the key signals that determine multi-location business visibility in AI search. The findings are directly relevant to enterprise brands with distributed location footprints such as automotive dealers or cruise port operations.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Brands Are Tracking AI Visibility, But Are They Measuring The Right Things?
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: AI visibility tools currently track brand mentions and citations, but marketers lack the outcome data needed to interpret those movements or determine next actions. The piece challenges enterprise teams to evaluate whether their current GEO measurement approach is actually tied to business results.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: How AI Is Reshaping Search Intent: What 2 Studies Reveal
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: Two studies show search intent is fracturing across AI Mode, video platforms, and zero-click results, with Google's own metrics indicating what actually earns clicks in the current environment. This is directly actionable for enterprise content strategy teams navigating AI-driven SERP changes.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Shopping Results Lean Hard On Product Feeds
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: ChatGPT Shopping is increasingly pulling product picks from feed-integrated sources, and store visibility has shifted accordingly. Enterprise retailers and travel brands with product or inventory feeds should evaluate their feed health as a GEO signal.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT, Gemini and Claude Lead AI Visibility: Is It Time To Stop Tracking Perplexity?
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article argues that reducing Perplexity's weight in AI search tracking can prevent distorted visibility scores while retaining its value as a competitive signal. Enterprise GEO teams prioritizing resource allocation across platforms will find this framing useful for benchmarking decisions.

AI Search / GEO.title: The AI Citation Mistake: Optimizing For Google, Not For Sources
AI Search / GEO.summary: Page-one Google rankings do not reliably earn AI citations from ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini, and the piece outlines which types of sources those platforms actually trust by industry. This is a critical strategic reframe for enterprise SEO teams conflating traditional ranking with AI-answer visibility.

AI Search / GEO.title: What 9 Months of AI Overview Data and 51,000+ Tracked Events Reveal
AI Search / GEO.summary: An analysis of more than 51,000 tracked AI Overview events over nine months surfaces patterns in when and how Google surfaces AI-generated answers. The longitudinal data set makes this one of the more evidence-based resources available for understanding AI Overview behavior at scale.

AI Search / GEO.title: Le Monde Says AI Overviews Haven't Hurt Its Audience So Far
AI Search / GEO.summary: Le Monde reports its audience has not declined since AI Overviews launched in France, with app traffic and subscriber growth complicating the broader narrative about AI-driven traffic loss for publishers. The finding is a useful data point for enterprise content teams assessing AI Overview risk to editorial-style pages.

AI Search / GEO.title: New Google Guide To Regional Search Features and Eligibility
AI Search / GEO.summary: Google has published new documentation mapping regional Search features available in the EEA, Turkiye, and South Africa, along with eligibility criteria and participation steps. Enterprise and travel brands with international footprints should review eligibility for region-specific SERP features.

AI Search / GEO.title: 10.7% of Top Sites Block AI Search Crawlers But Still Allow Googlebot
AI Search / GEO.summary: Data shows that 10.7% of top websites block AI search crawlers while continuing to allow Googlebot access, highlighting a growing divergence in crawl access policies between traditional and AI search infrastructure. Enterprise technical SEO teams should audit robots.txt and crawl directives for AI-specific bot targeting.

AI Search / GEO.title: News Publishers Expect Search Traffic to Drop 43% by 2029: Report
AI Search / GEO.summary: A report finds that news publishers anticipate a 43% drop in search referral traffic by 2029, driven by the expansion of AI-generated answers in search results. The projection is a benchmark data point for enterprise content and travel media teams building long-term traffic diversification plans.
